### Feature Summary
A concise explanation of the proposed feature.

### Problem Statement / Merchant Need
What merchant or operator problem does this address?

### Alignment with PRIP Invariants
- [ ] Conforms to single-tenant demo scope (no arbitrary scraping / multi-tenant bloat)
- [ ] AI remains explanatory only (no direct write or payment authority)
- [ ] Merchant approval is mandatory for all mutations
- [ ] Payment verification and capture remain strictly server-side
- [ ] Preserves four explicit inspection states

### Proposed Architecture & Module Ownership
Which modules (`backend/api`, `backend/services`, `frontend/features`, etc.) will own this functionality?

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Positive path tested
- [ ] Rejection/stale state tested
- [ ] Relevant documentation updated
